statement: WITH train_pairs AS (SELECT * FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_pairwise_estimates_20260612 WHERE split = 'train' AND n_antecedent >= 100), heldout_pairs AS (SELECT * FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_pairwise_estimates_20260612 WHERE split = 'heldout'), joined AS (SELECT t.antecedent_label, t.consequent_label, t.n_antecedent AS train_n_antecedent, t.confidence AS train_confidence, t.lift AS train_lift, h.n_antecedent AS heldout_n_antecedent, h.confidence AS heldout_confidence FROM train_pairs t INNER JOIN heldout_pairs h ON t.antecedent_label = h.antecedent_label AND t.consequent_label = h.consequent_label WHERE h.n_antecedent >= 20), binned AS (SELECT CASE WHEN train_confidence >= 0.95 THEN '0.95-1.00' WHEN train_confidence >= 0.90 THEN '0.90-0.95' WHEN train_confidence >= 0.80 THEN '0.80-0.90' WHEN train_confidence >= 0.70 THEN '0.70-0.80' WHEN train_confidence >= 0.60 THEN '0.60-0.70' WHEN train_confidence >= 0.50 THEN '0.50-0.60' ELSE '<0.50' END AS train_confidence_bin, * FROM joined) SELECT train_confidence_bin, COUNT(*) AS n_rules, ROUND(AVG(train_confidence), 4) AS avg_train_confidence, ROUND(AVG(heldout_confidence), 4) AS avg_heldout_confidence, ROUND(SUM(train_confidence * heldout_n_antecedent) / SUM(heldout_n_antecedent), 4) AS weighted_train_confidence, ROUND(SUM(heldout_confidence * heldout_n_antecedent) / SUM(heldout_n_antecedent), 4) AS weighted_heldout_confidence, ROUND(AVG(abs(train_confidence - heldout_confidence)), 4) AS avg_abs_delta FROM binned GROUP BY train_confidence_bin ORDER BY train_confidence_bin
